envelope.title: Start here · the DigiPlus Services story
envelope.body: DigiPlus Services is a fictional IT consulting and managed services company. Start with Atlas Client Portal: an identity verification check is blocked, two teams disagree about the Identity Gateway owner, and Northstar Logistics has a rollout promise. Other projects cover client delivery, claims, infrastructure, consultant staffing, partner services and reports. All people and records are invented. The demonstration guide explains the questions to ask; the agent answers from indexed evidence, not this guide.
